posts.name: Himanshu Kumar
posts.cooked:
Hey Guys,
For SCT and OPPE , is it mandatory to Chrome because I use Brave so will it work or i should install chrome..If anyone knows please guide..

posts.name: Anupam
posts.cooked:
Generally No Problem with any browser but sometimes some error with the site and it will fix easily on chrome and if you contact support they will say to use chrome because they made the website according to the chrome

So, for a safer side it is highly recommended to use Chrome Browser with latest updates.

posts.name: Anupam
posts.cooked:
After the Closing of Submission Window withing 3 to 5 days (Generally) you will see the result on the dashboard
if it is 1 Means you pass
if it is 0 Means you failed and have to re-do in second window and if in that you’re not pass then you have to wait for next term
